subject: a tiny octopus inside a transparent vinyl-record capsule
pose: arms curled along circular grooves around its body
requested_medium: detailed acrylic and vinyl object character
art_direction: 小章鱼藏在透明唱片舱内，短臂沿黑胶沟槽卷起，紫蓝光与蜜金眼神形成独特夜间静物角色。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Place a small violet octopus inside a clear acrylic capsule shaped like a thick vinyl record. Its short arms curl along the record grooves, forming a compact radial rhythm around a calm central face. Use small honey-colored eyes and no broad smile. The capsule has a black outer rim with one cyan light seam, while the grooves catch faint blue reflections. Render acrylic thickness, fine groove spacing, and soft skin planes without making the creature wet or slimy. Set the object against midnight navy with a narrow golden reflection below. Keep the entire disc centered within the square, with no labels, music notes, or other audio equipment.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for distinct original concept, appealing silhouette and expression, requested medium, coherent shape/anatomy, clean visual hierarchy, no text or watermark
